statement: ALMOST NO GENE IN THE APOE4-VS-APOE2 LC CONTRAST HOLDS IN BOTH ANCESTRY STRATA, AND APOE ITSELF DOES NOT. Supplementary Table 12's two within-ancestry sheets were scored gene by gene for concordance, defined as the same sign of effect in both the European- and African-ancestry strata, nominal significance in each, and no significant between-stratum heterogeneity by a GLS test that uses the measured between-domain error correlations (shared-spatial/errcorr.json, mean off-diagonal rho 0.124; the two strata are disjoint donor sets, so their errors are independent and the pooling is clean). Of 8,151 scorable genes, 212 are concordant, a base rate of 2.6 percent. Of the fifteen directionally significant genes drawn on the APOE homeostasis figure, only APOC1 and CD36 qualify. APOE itself is NOT concordant: its own effect is European-ancestry-specific, between-stratum p = 1.4e-07.
argument: The consequence is interpretive rather than technical, and it cuts across every claim already recorded from this dataset: a pooled APOE4-versus-APOE2 statement here is, by default, mostly a statement about the European-ancestry donors, because the gene whose genotype defines the contrast does not replicate across strata. A 2.6 percent concordance base rate also means that clearing pooled FDR is weak evidence of a general effect, so pooled hits should not be read as ancestry-independent without checking. This extends, and gives a denominator to, the already-recorded finding that the microglial signal is African-ancestry-specific and that the cytoribosome/OXPHOS equivalence is an ancestry artefact. Two caveats limit it. Nominal significance in BOTH strata is a demanding conjunction that will miss real shared effects at this sample size, so 2.6 percent is a floor on concordance, not an estimate of it; and a non-significant heterogeneity test is not evidence of homogeneity. Code: ~/apoe-research/endocytosis/ancestry_tier.py -> ancestry_tier.json (per-gene detail). This was derived while building a two-step evidence ramp for the figure's colour code; that encoding was reverted for an unrelated rendering defect, but the underlying tier assignment stands and is what the claim rests on.
